references.text: The same introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses shows the repeated way God communicates his commands throughout Numbers.
The Lord speaks to Moses and Aaron together, the same pattern as in 4:17 where both leaders receive instructions from God.
The Lord speaks to Moses with the same introductory formula, showing the continuity of God's revelation to Moses.
Another occurrence of the formula 'the Lord spoke to Moses' introducing divine instructions.
Moses and Aaron are mentioned together as recipients of the Lord's word, the same pattern as in Numbers 4:17.
The Lord speaks to Moses and Aaron together, showing their shared leadership in receiving and conveying God's laws.
The same structure where the Lord addresses both Moses and Aaron with instructions.
